themes.name: Oil shock
themes.backdrop: Crude is trading near $100 (Brent above $115) on U.S.-Iran tension and Houthi attacks on Saudi facilities. Mediation talks can knock it lower fast, so this ripple flips direction with headlines.

chain.label: Crude oil
chain.why: The starting push. Every stage below reacts to its price.

chain.label: Oil producers
chain.why: Each extra dollar per barrel flows almost straight to profit.

chain.label: Drillers & tankers
chain.why: High prices pull rigs back to work. Shipping disruption lifts tanker day-rates.

chain.label: Petrochemicals
chain.why: U.S. makers use cheap ethane from natural gas, so pricier oil hurts their overseas rivals more than them.

chain.label: Paint & coatings
chain.why: Resins and solvents are oil-derived. Costs jump first and price hikes catch up a quarter or two later, so margins get squeezed in between.

chain.label: Airlines
chain.why: Jet fuel is their second-biggest cost, and hedges only soften the blow.

chain.why: The starting push.

chain.label: Gas producers

chain.label: LNG exporters

chain.label: Fertilizer & chemicals
chain.why: Gas is the main feedstock for nitrogen fertilizer and U.S. ethylene, so pricier gas lifts their costs.
